titre: GTA 6 Sets New Record As Highest-Rated Video Game of All Time
chapo: Grand Theft Auto 6 is here and critics say it's one of the best games of all time, based on its 99 Metacritic score.
extrait: After more than a decade of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. Rockstar Games' new open-world crime adventure game is playable by the masses — at least in some parts of the world — and has been playable by critics for some time. GTA 6's review embargo lifted on Wednesday, Nov. 18, and more than a hundred reviews have been tabulated by Metacritic. The consensus is clear: GTA 6 is "monumental," "unbelievably fun," and "truly remarkable," critics say. The overwhelmingly positive critical response has helped GTA 6 set a new record: It's now the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic, where it currently sits above the previous title-holder, the original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. GTA 6 currently has a 99 Metascore (out of 100), the same score that Metacritic displays for Ocarina of Time. The latter score is based on just 22 critic reviews of the Nintendo 64 game. GTA 6's Metascore is based on more than 150. Both the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X versions of Grand Theft Auto 6 have a 99 Metascore, signaling "universal acclaim," according to Metacritic. The achievement puts GTA 6 atop a very strong top 10 on Metacritic — and knocks another Rockstar Games release out of the site's top 10 list. Here's the current top 10 on Metacritic, as of Nov. 18, the day before Grand Theft Auto 6 officially launches: Rockstar's Red Dead Redemption 2 held the No. 10 position until today, with its 97 Metascore. In Polygon's review of GTA 6, critic Giovanni Colantonio lauded the game for its immersion, storytelling, and depth. "GTA once again earns its title as public enemy #1 — only this time, Rockstar accomplishes that less through bloodshed and more with an empathetic love story built for an era of stark economic uncertainty," Colantonio wrote. "It’s a bold choice, considering the series’ cold-blooded reputation, but it’s also what makes GTA 6 one of Rockstar’s finest games to date." Grand Theft Auto 6 was nominated for eight awards, including Game of the Year, at this year's The Game Awards on Tuesday, making it an early frontrunner for multiple GOTY awards. Ahead of launch, the game has reportedly sold more than 17 million copies, according to Sensor Tower, earning $1.65 billion in revenue for Rockstar Games and publisher Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto 6 officially launches on Nov. 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X.

titre: GTA 6 is Now The Joint-Highest Rated Game of All Time
chapo: GTA 6 has become the joint-highest rated game of all time, following the widespread publication of reviews.
extrait: GTA 6 has become the joint-highest rated game of all time, following the widespread publication of reviews in the past hour. Rockstar's masterpiece currently sits with an all-time best score of 99 on Metacritic, an honor shared only with Nintendo's original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time release back in 1997 on N64, almost 30 years ago. No other game since has managed such a feat. (The new version of Ocarina for Switch 2 managed a paltry score of just 96.) While both the N64 version of Ocarina and GTA 6 share a 99 average, GTA 6 has impressively managed to pull this off with more than six times' the number of reviews — over 120 at the time of writing, with over 100 of those listed with a perfect score. And while it's possible GTA 6's ranking could still slip down a point as more reviews are published, it would still be the best-rated game in nearly three decades. Few others titles released in the recent memory have come anywhere close to this — though if you head back to the last console generation, Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Super Mario Odyssey both managed a 97 average, a standing they share with Rockstar's own Red Dead Redemption 2. IGN's GTA 6 review is of course now live, and also returned a perfect 10/10 score. We described it as "exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered," as well as "unprecedented, unbelievable and unmissable." IGN has everything you need for the launch of GTA 6, including the GTA 6 global release times, as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download. In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia. And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog, which we'll use to fill you in on everything else about the game over the coming hours. Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. The GTA 6 Metacritic score is here, and perhaps unsurprisingly, it's not only the highest rated game of 2026, but the highest-rated game of all time. If you look at the Metacritic "Best Games of All Time" list, there's a couple things you're going to notice – namely, Nintendo and Rockstar Games, or more specifically, Mario, Zelda, and Grand Theft Auto. And now joining GTA 4 and GTA 5 as one of the highest-rated games of all time is GTA 6, with reviews awarding it a score of 99 after 107 reviews. This makes it the highest rated game of 2026, and matches the original N64 release of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the highest-rated game ever. You just need to look at the GamesRadar+ GTA 6 review to see why, with editor-in-chief Josh West awarding the latest Rockstar Games title 5/5, saying "Rockstar has built an open world of truly astonishing scale, scope, and quality," and adding that "there's no aspect of the series' gameplay that hasn't been improved over past instalments." Perhaps unsurprisingly, there's a lot of outlets giving Rockstar's latest full marks, with the likes of IGN, TechRadar Gaming, Edge, and Game Informer being among the many outlets giving the max score. And as of right now there are no reviews that Metacritic classes as "Negative," or even "Mixed" for that matter. Obviously, this Metacritic score and the game's eight nominations at The Game Awards 2026 is just the cherry on top for Rockstar, as the game is already estimated to have made $1.45 billion from pre-orders alone, and as the game releases in New Zealand right about now, I imagine that number will be far surpassed as people dig into the game.
